actions.name: reflective carapace
actions.desc: Any time the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is targeted by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.41JIhpDyM9Anm7cs]{magic missile} spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected. On a 6, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, turning the caster into the target.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .WGGtJeKC6RjDyMC2]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes five attacks: one with its [[/item .suUr7bJqBqE7xk2F]]{bite}, two with its [[/item .7DRko62ztr6FjZLA]]{claws}, one with its [[/item .E1RZdzEY2qnG2jLn]]{horns}, and one with its [[/item .Lo4LU9FBxez1Nzqm]]{tail}. It can use its [[/item .7ycN6rrAEJQP3ZOs]]{Swallow} instead of its bite.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature, it is &reference[grappled] (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is &reference[restrained], and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't [[lookup @item.name lowercase]] another target.

actions.name: tail
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be knocked &reference[prone].

actions.name: attack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .7DRko62ztr6FjZLA]]{claw} attack or [[/item .Lo4LU9FBxez1Nzqm]]{tail} attack.

actions.name: move
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its speed.

actions.name: chomp
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .suUr7bJqBqE7xk2F]]{bite} attack or uses its [[/item .7ycN6rrAEJQP3ZOs]]{Swallow}.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: siege monster
actions.desc: The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: frightful presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=2VOmvThI0bGdUsMt]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=2VOmvThI0bGdUsMt]]. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .suUr7bJqBqE7xk2F]]{Bite} attack against a Medium or smaller target it is &reference[grappling]. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is &reference[blinded] and &reference[restrained], it has &reference[total cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and it takes [[/damage average activity=JiBTCgEtAZs60k7R]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. A [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save activity=2pCVkETAYg7qALRu]] saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting &reference[prone].
